en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide city street with horse‑drawn carriages, an early tram, gas street lamps, and pedestrians. On the left stands a neoclassical church with a bell tower and large dome, fronted by columns. The street runs into the distance between multi‑story stone buildings. Printed text in Russian and French at the top identifies the location as St. Petersburg and Sergievskaya Street.
